title: feat: make events default implementation compatible with composition API
body:
**Summary**

[EMERCH-1902](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/EMERCH-1902)

Update events default implementation to make it compatible with Composition API, *i.e.*

Before:

* events are sending an `index` property
* it currently often relies on `getIndex()` which returns the `compositionID` when using the Composition implementation of InstantSearch
* this results in events being "lost" as the insights API is not aware of Compositions

After:

* when sending events, for the `index` property,
* first rely on the `index` property in the results (id present)
* only rely on `getIndex()` as a fallback

**Result**

* when using the index implementation, nothing should change
* when using the composition implementation, the main index (send under `results.index` in the API response) is used when sending events (previsously composition ID)
